body:
Morning scrape is done. Overnight window archived — you were asleep, so it was 8 assistant messages, nothing from you, all landed in the raw archive and the private backup.

Spotify snapshot shows paused on an ad in the FUNDAMENTAL FLAW crate. No new posts anywhere: Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Messenger all quiet. Device texts still have no read path.

One notable thing logged: your ihatedanfrank Claude Pro expired at midnight last night, so the leftover work queues got re-routed to the dfrank88 account. That Google device check is still waiting on you tapping Yes on your iPhone (the 97 prompt in Gmail).

Still open: your iPhone tap for the dfrank88 batch, about 83 of the 2010 texts still missing — the hotline's open whenever you drop the file, and the Drive quota is still full so the nightly backup is stuck on your local machine until you free space.

Token check, 7:05–8:05am: 14.9M total (14.8M in / 81k out). Heaviest: wiki-brain-scrape (7.5M), then stylo-v3-burnin-30m (3.0M). Biggest single inference: wiki-brain-scrape at 7.4M. Up ~104% vs last hour.
Merged PR #132 — the rolling Sammy ingest, 8 files, all additive, checks green.
